decisive_items: Nailfold examination showed dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)
response.rationale: The combination of clinical and laboratory findings, including nailfold changes, elevated IFN-β levels, and presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies, are highly specific for juvenile dermatomyositis
